title: GST Invoice & Tax Compliance
content: All invoices include GST as per Indian tax law. CGST + SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state transactions. GSTIN is displayed on every invoice. To download GST invoice: Billing > Invoices > Download. Invoice format complies with GST Council rules. For GST input credit, download invoice from Billing > Tax Documents. State-wise GST rates apply (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%). Our service falls under SAC 998314 (IT software services) at 18% GST. For B2B transactions, provide your GSTIN at checkout for proper invoicing. Reverse charge mechanism applies for certain services as per Section 9(3) of CGST Act.
